locator: Sec. 5, the MBB beam (Appendix C, Fig. 5)

items.description: The element counts are specified, but element spacings are not. A 3:1 domain requires assuming square elements.
readings: 144 by 48 square elements, giving a domain aspect ratio of 3:1.
144 by 48 rectangular elements with horizontal spacing twice the vertical spacing, giving a domain aspect ratio of 6:1.
items.evidence: Appendix C, opening paragraph specifies Nx by Ny = 144 by 48 without physical dimensions or element spacings.

items.entity: Volume conservation between projected and physical densities
items.description: The 30% constraint is imposed on the intermediate density field, but the MBB example does not select between the two stated Heaviside threshold rules. Consequently, the volume of the physical density field is underdetermined.
readings: Constrain the intermediate densities to 30% and determine the Heaviside threshold by bisection to conserve volume across that projection.
Constrain the intermediate densities to 30% and fix the Heaviside threshold at 0.5, allowing the physical volume fraction to differ.
items.evidence: Appendix C specifies the 30% target; Section 5, Eq. (14) constrains the intermediate densities; the text following Eq. (17) permits either a volume-conserving threshold or a fixed threshold of 0.5 without selecting one for Fig. 5.
